chapterInfo.content:
44
Akane ne nnɛ
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfoɔ. Kora mma nnweneho dwom.
1 # Deut 6.20-25 Onyankopɔn, yɛde yɛn aso ate,
yɛn agyanom aka akyerɛ yɛn sɛ:
Woayɛ adwuma bi wɔn berɛ so,
tete mmerɛ no mu.
2Wode wo nsa pamm amanaman,
na wɔn deɛ, woduaa wɔn.
Wobɔɔ aman, na wɔn deɛ,
wotrɛɛ wɔn mu.
3Na ɛnyɛ wɔn ara afena na wɔde nyaa asase no,
nanso ɛnyɛ wɔn ara nsa na ɛgyee wɔn,
na mmom ɛyɛ wo nifa ne wo basa
ne w’anim hann,
ɛfiri sɛ wopɛ wɔn.
4 # Dwom 74.12 Wo, Onyankopɔn, wone me Hene,
hyɛ na Yakob nnya nkwagyeɛ ara nko.
5Wo so na yɛnam sum ahohiahiafoɔ guo,
wo din mu na yɛtiatia wɔn a wɔsɔre tia yɛn no soɔ.
6 # Dwom 20.7 Na memfa me ho mento me tadua so,
na m’afena nso rennye me.
7Na woagye yɛn yɛn ahohiahiafoɔ nsam,
na woahyɛ wɔn a wɔtane yɛn aniwuo.
8Nyankopɔn mu na yɛhoahoa yɛn ho da mu nyinaa,
na yɛyi wo din ayɛ daapem.
9Nanso woato yɛn agu, na woabɔ yɛn ahohora,
na wo ne yɛn dɔm ankɔ.
10Womaa yɛdanee yɛn akyiri kyerɛɛ yɛn ahodwanfoɔ,
na wɔn a wɔtane yɛn fom yɛn fa.
11Wode yɛn maa sɛ nnwan a wɔdie,
na woabɔ yɛn ahwete amanaman mu.
12Woantɔn wo nkurɔfoɔ annye hwee,
woamfa wɔn annye aboɔden.
13 # Dwom 79.4; 1 Ah 9.7 Wode yɛn asi hɔ ama wɔn a wɔtete yɛn ho nsopa,
ama wɔn a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia no fɛdie, ne ehuro.
14Wode yɛn ayɛ akasabebuo amanaman mu,
woma aman bobɔ wɔn tiri nko wɔ yɛn ho.
15Daa nyinaa m’ahohora da m’anim,
na aniwuo akata me so,
16deɛ ɔbɔ me ahohora na ɔsopa me no nne
ne ɔtamfoɔ ne ɔweretɔfoɔ nti.
17Yei nyinaa aba yɛn so,
nanso yɛn werɛ mfirii wo,
na yɛntwaa w’apam no ho nkontompo.
18Yɛn akoma nsanee n’akyi,
na yɛn anammɔn nteree wo kwan ho.
19Nanso woabubu yɛn pasaa, deɛ sakraman wɔ,
na wode esum kabii akata yɛn so.
20Sɛ yɛn werɛ afiri yɛn Nyankopɔn din
anaasɛ yɛatrɛ yɛn nsam akyerɛ onyame foforɔ a,
21 # Dwom 7.9 ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔbɛhwehwɛ?
Na ɔno na ɔnim akoma mu ahuntasɛm.
22 # Rom 8.36 Na wo nti na wɔku yɛn daa nyinaa,
wɔbu yɛn sɛ nnwan a wɔrekɔku wɔn.
23 # Dwom 35.23 AWURADE, nyane ɛ, adɛn nti na woda?
Sɔre ɛ, nto yɛn ntwene koraa.
24 # Dwom 10.1 Adɛn nti na woyi w’ani hunta,
na wo werɛ firi yɛn amaneɛ ne yɛn so hyɛ no?
25Na wɔabrɛ yɛn kra ase kɔ mfuturo mu,
yɛn yafunu butu fam.
26Sɔre bɛboa yɛn ɛ,
na gye yɛn, w’adɔeɛ nti!

Onyankopɔn, yɛde yɛn aso ate,
yɛn agyanom aka akyerɛ yɛn sɛ:
Woayɛ adwuma bi wɔn berɛ so,
tete mmerɛ no mu.
Wode wo nsa pamm amanaman,
na wɔn deɛ, woduaa wɔn.
Wobɔɔ aman, na wɔn deɛ,
wotrɛɛ wɔn mu.
Na ɛnyɛ wɔn ara afena na wɔde nyaa asase no,
nanso ɛnyɛ wɔn ara nsa na ɛgyee wɔn,
na mmom ɛyɛ wo nifa ne wo basa
ne w’anim hann,
ɛfiri sɛ wopɛ wɔn.
Wo, Onyankopɔn, wone me Hene,
hyɛ na Yakob nnya nkwagyeɛ ara nko.
Wo so na yɛnam sum ahohiahiafoɔ guo,
wo din mu na yɛtiatia wɔn a wɔsɔre tia yɛn no soɔ.
Na memfa me ho mento me tadua so,
na m’afena nso rennye me.
Na woagye yɛn yɛn ahohiahiafoɔ nsam,
na woahyɛ wɔn a wɔtane yɛn aniwuo.
Nyankopɔn mu na yɛhoahoa yɛn ho da mu nyinaa,
na yɛyi wo din ayɛ daapem.
Nanso woato yɛn agu, na woabɔ yɛn ahohora,
na wo ne yɛn dɔm ankɔ.
Womaa yɛdanee yɛn akyiri kyerɛɛ yɛn ahodwanfoɔ,
na wɔn a wɔtane yɛn fom yɛn fa.
Wode yɛn maa sɛ nnwan a wɔdie,
na woabɔ yɛn ahwete amanaman mu.
Woantɔn wo nkurɔfoɔ annye hwee,
woamfa wɔn annye aboɔden.
Wode yɛn asi hɔ ama wɔn a wɔtete yɛn ho nsopa,
ama wɔn a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia no fɛdie, ne ehuro.
Wode yɛn ayɛ akasabebuo amanaman mu,
woma aman bobɔ wɔn tiri nko wɔ yɛn ho.
Daa nyinaa m’ahohora da m’anim,
na aniwuo akata me so,
deɛ ɔbɔ me ahohora na ɔsopa me no nne
ne ɔtamfoɔ ne ɔweretɔfoɔ nti.
Yei nyinaa aba yɛn so,
nanso yɛn werɛ mfirii wo,
na yɛntwaa w’apam no ho nkontompo.
Yɛn akoma nsanee n’akyi,
na yɛn anammɔn nteree wo kwan ho.
Nanso woabubu yɛn pasaa, deɛ sakraman wɔ,
na wode esum kabii akata yɛn so.
Sɛ yɛn werɛ afiri yɛn Nyankopɔn din
anaasɛ yɛatrɛ yɛn nsam akyerɛ onyame foforɔ a,
ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔbɛhwehwɛ?
Na ɔno na ɔnim akoma mu ahuntasɛm.
Na wo nti na wɔku yɛn daa nyinaa,
wɔbu yɛn sɛ nnwan a wɔrekɔku wɔn.
AWURADE, nyane ɛ, adɛn nti na woda?
Sɔre ɛ, nto yɛn ntwene koraa.
Adɛn nti na woyi w’ani hunta,
na wo werɛ firi yɛn amaneɛ ne yɛn so hyɛ no?
Na wɔabrɛ yɛn kra ase kɔ mfuturo mu,
yɛn yafunu butu fam.
Sɔre bɛboa yɛn ɛ,
na gye yɛn, w’adɔeɛ nti!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
